title: primula denticulata subsp. harsukhii
intro: Primula denticulata subsp. harsukhii, commonly known as Himalayan Primrose, is a plant species in the primrose family (Primulaceae) native to the Himalayas. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Primula denticulata subsp. harsukhii include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being researched, but it is believed to contain flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
